Vijayanagara Empire.claim: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336.
Harihara I and Bukka Raya I founded the Vijayanagara Empire.
The Battle of Talikota was fought in 1565.
Hampi was the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.
The Vijayanagara Empire was founded by Shivaji.
The Battle of Talikota was fought in 1665.
Delhi was the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.

Shivaji and the Maratha Empire.claim: Shivaji was crowned at Raigad Fort in 1674.
Shivaji was born at Shivneri Fort.
Afzal Khan was killed at Pratapgad in 1659.
The Third Battle of Panipat was fought in 1761 against Ahmad Shah Durrani.
The Marathas won the Third Battle of Panipat.

Roman Empire.claim: Augustus was the first Roman emperor.
The Western Roman Empire is conventionally said to have ended in 476 AD.
Constantine the Great founded Constantinople as a new capital.
Julius Caesar was the first Roman emperor.
The Western Roman Empire fell in 1066.
Rome was the capital of the Eastern Roman Empire.

Great Wall of China.claim: Most of the Great Wall that survives today was built during the Ming dynasty.
Qin Shi Huang joined earlier walls together into a single defensive system.
The Great Wall of China is visible from the Moon with the naked eye.
The entire Great Wall was built within a single decade.

Mughal Empire.claim: Babur founded the Mughal Empire after the First Battle of Panipat in 1526.
Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal.
Babur founded the Mughal Empire in 1626.
Aurangzeb was the founder of the Mughal Empire.

Napoleon.claim: Napoleon was defeated at the Battle of Waterloo in 1815.
Napoleon was exiled to the island of Saint Helena.
Napoleon won the Battle of Waterloo.
